name: co.lumineapp/lumine
title: lumine
description: lumine is completely free for everyone: private creator-brand matching with double-opt-in intros.

tools.name: list_open_briefs
tools.description: A few featured public creator briefs (UGC, creator roles, hosting, ambassador), rotated daily, copied from live public postings and verified. Filter by region, category or keyword. Apply on each brief's apply_url, or submit a listing to be matched and introduced instead.

tools.name: preview_match
tools.description: Send a creator or brand profile and get a readiness score, missing fields, and which public briefs fit and why. Stores nothing and never reveals private listings. Use before submitting.

email.description: Only counted as present or missing. Never stored or echoed.

platform.description: One of the platforms people can pick on /list.

handle.description: Handle or link for this platform. Optional on brands; used for a creator's main handle.

main.description: True if this is the main platform. Defaults to the first entry if none is marked.

text.description: The custom platform name. Required when platform is Other.

platforms.description: Optional. If sent, this is stored and the single platform/handle fields are taken from the main entry. If omitted, the single platform field works as before.

remote_ok.description: Creator is open to remote briefs. Defaults to true.

tools.name: submit_creator_listing
tools.description: Create a private, free creator listing for a person who asked you to. The creator must be 18+. lumine emails the creator a one-click confirmation; nothing is matched until they confirm. Returns listing_id and status_token.

name.description: Creator's name as they want it shown in an intro.

email.description: Creator's own email, never the agent's. Confirmations and intros go here.

handle.description: Main social handle, with or without @.

platform.description: Main platform when sending only one. Still accepted. Instagram, YouTube or TikTok.

platforms.description: Optional. If sent, this is stored and the single platform/handle fields are taken from the main entry. If omitted, the single platform field works as before.

niche.description: For example Beauty, Food, Tech, Music, Slow fashion.

bio.description: Two lines about what they make.

age_confirmed_18_plus.description: Required. The creator is 18 or older. lumine does not accept listings for minors.

name.description: Name of the agent or product submitting, for example 'Acme Talent Assistant'.

url.description: Homepage of the agent or its operator.

contact_email.description: Where lumine can reach the agent operator about abuse or errors.

on_behalf_of.description: Who the listing is for: the agent's own principal, an agency client, or the operator itself.

principal_authorized.description: The person or brand asked the agent to list them on lumine.

agrees_to_privacy_policy.description: The person accepts https://lumineapp.co/privacy and https://lumineapp.co/terms.

contact_for_intros.description: lumine may contact the person by email or Instagram DM with intros.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse on retries to avoid duplicate listings.

tools.name: submit_brand_listing
tools.description: Create a private, free brand listing for a brand that asked you to. lumine emails the brand contact a one-click confirmation; nothing is matched until they confirm. Returns listing_id and status_token.

email.description: Brand contact's own email, never the agent's. Confirmations and intros go here.

platform.description: One of the platforms people can pick on /list.

tools.name: get_listing_status
tools.description: Status of a listing you submitted: pending_confirmation, confirmed, in_review, matched, intro_sent, closed, declined or expired. Needs the status_token from the submit call. Never returns listing details.

listing_id.description: listing_id returned by a submit tool.

status_token.description: status_token returned by a submit tool.

tools.name: submit_agency_roster
tools.description: Bulk-list up to 100 creators or brands an agency represents. The agency contact confirms the roster by email first, then every member confirms their own listing. Nobody is matched before their own yes.

email.description: Agency contact email. Confirms the roster when email confirmation is on.

name.description: Name of the agent or product submitting, for example 'Acme Talent Assistant'.

url.description: Homepage of the agent or its operator.

contact_email.description: Where lumine can reach the agent operator about abuse or errors.

on_behalf_of.description: Who the listing is for: the agent's own principal, an agency client, or the operator itself.

agency_represents_each_member.description: The agency represents every person or brand in the roster.

members_may_be_emailed.description: lumine may email each member about their own listing.

creators_are_18_plus.description: Every creator in the roster is 18 or older.

tools.name: get_roster_status
tools.description: Counts by status for a roster you submitted. Needs the roster_status_token. Never returns member details.

tools.name: create_prefill_link
tools.description: Build a lumineapp.co/list link with fields filled in, for a person who prefers to review and send the form themselves. Nothing is saved until they press send.

tools.name: get_about
tools.description: What lumine is, how matching and intros work, rules for agents, limits and links.
